text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't know how many times I raced Tannhauser on the beach… Nature never told us to stop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then Urara went off on her own to that deserted island, and Rice wouldn't stop crying…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This has been the most tiring camp since I entered Tracen.
choice_data_list: But you look like you had fun!
But you look like you had fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like hell I do! You want your butt kicked?!
We have some truly enriching days leading up to the autumn Tenno Sho!
